title: Exploring unanswerability in machine reading comprehension: approaches, benchmarks, and open challenges
core_idea: Provide a comprehensive review of methods for handling unanswerable questions in machine reading comprehension by categorizing approaches into model-agnostic and model-specific, surveying key strategies, datasets, and evaluation metrics, and identifying gaps and challenges to guide future research toward more robust MRC systems.
tldr: A survey that categorizes and analyzes approaches, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics for unanswerable questions in machine reading comprehension, highlighting open challenges to steer future work.
